purpose: Provide an elegant, information-rich overview of the working definition, AI selection challenge, concrete practice, context and the notice/choose/refine loop.
alt: Taste: Knowing what’s good in the AI era. A creator compares designs in a futuristic studio. AI expands the possibilities. Taste gives them direction. What is taste? Developed discernment: notice, choose and shape quality for a purpose, audience and point of view. Why it matters with AI: more options do not automatically mean better selection. Decide what to keep and improve. How to develop it: compare work in one domain. Explain your choices. Make, critique and revise. Seek informed feedback. Keep perspective: preference, expertise and status affect judgment. Context matters. Good choices can differ. Notice: recognize differences. Choose: judge fit. Refine: improve through feedback. Develop reasons for your choices. Stay open to revision.
